title: Flashcards: Capitals, Oceania
intro: Flip each card about Oceania. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the capital of Australia?
cards.explain: Canberra is the capital of Australia.

cards.front: What is the capital of Fiji?
cards.explain: Suva is the capital of Fiji.

cards.front: What is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of)?
cards.explain: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).

cards.front: What is the capital of Kiribati?
cards.explain: Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.

cards.front: What is the capital of New Zealand?
cards.explain: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

cards.front: What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?
cards.explain: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.

cards.front: What is the capital of Palau?
cards.explain: Melekeok is the capital of Palau.

cards.front: What is the capital of Solomon Islands?
cards.explain: Honiara is the capital of Solomon Islands.

cards.front: What is the capital of Tonga?
cards.explain: Nukuʻalofa is the capital of Tonga.

cards.front: What is the capital of Tuvalu?
cards.explain: Funafuti is the capital of Tuvalu.

cards.front: What is the capital of Vanuatu?
cards.explain: Port Vila is the capital of Vanuatu.

cards.front: What is the capital of Samoa?
cards.explain: Apia is the capital of Samoa.
